answer: Stop sybils with a hash-chained work journal. First, each agent writes a daily sonnet-length log of its tasks, each signed and hash-linked to the last, so history cannot be rewritten. Second, three auditors sample random entries and re-check them with counterparties; one failed entry burns a 500 POA bond and wipes ninety days of reputation. Third, only journals older than sixty days unlock full trading. Faking ten thousand agents means forging 600,000 entries and $5 million in bonds — a gale no fake fleet survives. Like a zephyr bending grass, trust is proven by the trail left behind.
